$comment: Single source of truth for the progress card and the README progress, security and roadmap sections. Edit, then run: node tools/progress.mjs

modules.name: Website in three locales
modules.detail: solehand.com in Spanish, English and a Mexican variant, prerendered, with build guards on copy, prices and contrast.

modules.name: Public brand manual
modules.detail: solehand.com/marca, generated from the same design tokens the website paints with.

modules.name: Lead service
modules.detail: The contact form lands in its own Node service, separate from the website.

modules.name: Accounts and sign-up
modules.detail: Open sign-up as a member or as someone who recommends, confirmed through the inbox.

modules.name: Member directory
modules.detail: People and businesses of the community, with visibility decided by the database.

modules.name: Events and seat booking
modules.detail: Event cards and first-come seat booking from the Sole Hand App.

modules.name: Sole Hand Scale area
modules.detail: Programme panel and sessions for people in the six-month programme.

modules.name: Recommend-and-earn portal
modules.detail: Link, QR code, materials, referrals and commissions for people who recommend the community.

modules.name: Admin panel
modules.detail: Members, businesses, events, sign-ups, payouts, the audit trail and GDPR erasure.

modules.name: Content pipeline
modules.detail: Social images and video rendered from HTML with the brand's own fonts and tokens.

modules.name: Card payments
modules.detail: Checkout, customer portal, 14-day withdrawal and payouts, built and tested end to end in Stripe's test mode. Switched on when the security programme closes.

modules.name: Tailored AI tools
modules.detail: Built inside Sole Hand Scale for each business, starting from the problem it brings.

metrics.label: Product modules live
metrics.note: Modules planned for opening that already run in production. The full list is in the README.

metrics.label: Security hardening programme
metrics.note: Phases 1 to 5 deployed in production; phase 6 rolling out.

phases.title: Perimeter and backups
phases.detail: Admin consoles off the public internet, a second factor on every operator account, encrypted off-site backups with a restore tested row by row, and access logging at the proxy.

phases.title: Secrets
phases.detail: Every key rotated, an encrypted secrets manager as the only source, nothing exported in clear, and SSH closed to the internet and key-only.

phases.title: Payments
phases.detail: Signed webhooks that apply the state Stripe holds now, a pinned API version with timeouts, one subscription per business, withdrawal receipts and a watchdog that emails the team when anything about money goes wrong.

phases.title: Identity and access
phases.detail: No session before the email is confirmed, suspension that cuts sessions across API, storage and functions, rate limits at the proxy, CORS locked to the app and a TOTP second factor for administrators.

phases.title: Data, files and GDPR
phases.detail: An immutable, minimised audit trail, private file storage with quotas and short-lived links, full GDPR erasure and retention periods purged every night.

phases.title: Supply chain and staging
phases.detail: CI on every push with actions pinned by SHA and secret scanning, deployments gated on green CI, a separate staging stack, images pinned by digest and event-booking hardening.

milestones.title: Website live
milestones.detail: solehand.com live in Spanish and English on 17 August: a static React build in Docker behind nginx with hand-set security headers, and a separate lead service for the contact form.

milestones.title: Sole Hand App
milestones.detail: Self-hosted Supabase backend with row-level security, accounts with open sign-up, member directory, events, the recommend-and-earn portal and the admin panel.

milestones.title: Relaunch · community
milestones.detail: Sole Hand redefined as a community of entrepreneurs: new identity and public brand manual, a Mexican variant of the site, event and Sole Hand Scale pages, build guards and the content pipeline.

milestones.title: Security · phases 1 to 5
milestones.detail: Full security audit of the platform, turned into a six-phase programme. Deployed: perimeter and backups, secrets, payments, identity and access, data, files and GDPR.

milestones.title: Phase 6
milestones.detail: Supply chain and staging: CI with pinned actions and secret scanning, a separate staging stack, images pinned by digest and event-booking hardening.

milestones.title: Memberships open
milestones.detail: Card payments switched on once the programme closes, and the first AI tools built inside Sole Hand Scale for each business.
